opening.argument: The speaker urges viewers to join USI Tech through an external sign-up site and describes buying a package that pays 1% each working day for roughly 140 working days. A purchase page displays the package runtime and daily-payout figures, while the speaker claims that full reinvestment will double the amount put in. He also mentions a referral program and offers a group invitation to people who join through his link. The speaker does caution that participants entrust money to someone else and could lose it. But that warning does not change the substance of the pitch: viewers are encouraged to participate on the basis of stated daily returns and doubling through reinvestment.
